skill.description: 查台灣各縣市與測站的每小時空氣品質指標（AQI）、主要污染物、PM2.5、PM10 與發布時間。今天空氣好嗎、空氣污染、AQI、PM2.5、敏感族群適不適合外出的問題適用。使用環境部官方 AQX_P_432 資料集，需要免費註冊取得 MOENV API 金鑰。
skill.summary: Retrieve Taiwan station AQI, pollutant readings, and publication times from the official hourly dataset.
skill.author: tahodev

security_audit.summary: Most detections reflect Markdown formatting, official URLs, credential documentation, or readable multilingual text; no evidence found of prompt injection or malicious exfiltration. The fixed temporary-file output can enable symlink overwrite, and the expanded curl argument can expose the API key through process listings. These two findings are confirmed; all other static findings are false positives.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md:35 writes downloaded data to a predictable shared temporary-file path.
remediation.suggestion: Create a private temporary directory with mktemp, use its file for every query, and remove the directory after processing.

remediation.issue: SKILL.md:34 expands the API key into a curl argument visible through process inspection on some systems.
remediation.suggestion: Pass authentication through a protected curl configuration or standard input, not expanded command arguments; redact request URLs and disable shell tracing.

content.user_title: Check Taiwan Air Quality by County or Station
content.value_statement: Air quality differs between stations, and delayed readings can misrepresent current conditions. This skill retrieves official hourly Taiwan AQI data with pollutants and publication times.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve the official AQX_P_432 dataset through an authenticated HTTPS request.
Filter stations by county and normalize alternative Chinese spellings of county names.
Compare county stations by AQI without presenting one station as a county-wide measurement.
Query an exact station name or list candidate station names when the location is uncertain.
Report AQI, source status, dominant pollutant, particulate concentrations, and publication time.
Identify missing readings, delayed timestamps, authentication errors, and unavailable API responses.
limitations: Requires a registered MOENV API key, network access, and a shell with curl and jq.
Provides hourly station observations, not forecasts or street-level exposure measurements.
Cannot reconstruct missing readings or replace unavailable data with remembered values.
Provides general AQI information, not medical diagnoses or personalized health assessments.

use_cases.title: Review local conditions
use_cases.description: Check a nearby monitoring station before planning outdoor travel, using its AQI status and publication time.

use_cases.title: Compare monitoring stations
use_cases.description: List county stations by AQI and inspect particulate readings without treating one measurement as a county-wide value.

use_cases.title: Prepare an air quality briefing
use_cases.description: Summarize official station readings with source status, timestamps, and explicit notes about missing or delayed data.

prompt_templates.title: Compare county stations
prompt_templates.prompt: List Taipei City monitoring stations from highest to lowest AQI. Include publication times and identify missing readings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: compare stations within one county.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve an uncertain station
prompt_templates.prompt: Find candidate stations for my location in New Taipei City. Ask me to choose if the station name is ambiguous.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: clarify the monitoring location before reporting.

prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve New Taipei City station data. Report AQI, status, pollutant, PM2.5 averages, and timestamps; flag missing or delayed values without estimating.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: inspect data completeness and publication times.

best_practices: Check publication times and preserve missing readings before describing current conditions.
Keep API keys out of replies, logs, and process arguments; use protected authentication input.
Use a private temporary directory and identify each station when comparing county readings.
anti_patterns: Treating the highest station AQI as a single measurement for an entire county.
Replacing missing or delayed readings with guessed values or remembered observations.
Publishing API keys or presenting AQI information as personalized medical advice.

faq.question: Which source does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses the Ministry of Environment AQX_P_432 dataset from Taiwan's official environmental open-data platform.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Register for a free MOENV key and keep it in secure credential storage or the MOENV_API_KEY environment variable.

faq.question: How often are readings updated?
faq.answer: The dataset updates hourly. Always check each station's publication time because readings may be delayed.

faq.question: Can I search by county or station?
faq.answer: Yes. County queries normalize alternative Chinese spellings, while station queries use exact names and can list candidates.

faq.question: What happens when a reading is missing?
faq.answer: The skill marks the reading as unavailable and does not estimate it. Other stations in the same county may be reported separately.

faq.question: Can this skill decide whether an activity is medically safe?
faq.answer: No. It provides general AQI information and official standards, not individualized medical advice.
